lines.says: the elbows open to near straight at the top and close to about a right angle or less at the bottom
the hips stay on the pad
the head stays on the pad
the shoulders stay pinned to the pad
the bar travels on a near-straight line, chest to over the shoulders
the upper arms keep their angle to the trunk: no tuck and flare mid-rep
